about: The collect of the feast of the Most Holy Trinity. It joins confession of true faith in the Trinity to adoration of the unity of the divine majesty and asks that steadfast faith protect the faithful.

seg.tr: Almighty, everlasting God, who hast given Thy servants, in the confession of the true faith, to acknowledge the glory of the eternal Trinity and in the power of majesty to adore the Unity: we beseech Thee that, by the steadfastness of that same faith, we may ever be defended from all adversities. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
